name: Hurdle Lane and the blind loading lanes (Andorhal granary district)
region: Andorhal granary district, behind the Mill Lane yards

sensoryProfile.sight: Runs along the backs of the granaries, wide enough for one wagon and a man flat against the wall. Granaries stand over it on stone feet, timber from the first floor up, hoist beams jutting overhead with slack ropes. In shadow end to end. Every few yards another loading lane comes in from one side or other, every one blind: walls run to the corner so a stride into it cannot be seen until you stand in its mouth. Soft mortar between stones in the first loading lane's mouth, with a crack at hip height. Garside's back gate with a boy lighting the lamp on the gatepost.
sensoryProfile.sound: Wagons backing out of lanes without warning; axles squealing loud enough to drown footsteps.
sensoryProfile.touch: Dust floured on the cobbles; shadowed, close.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Good for the cult, bad for a tail: a maze of blind corners and ordinary labour noise.

establishedFacts.fact: Havel's route to Fenner's: Hurdle Lane from the post, behind Holt's, past Garside's back gate, out at the rope-walk end of Fenner's; 'my lads walk Hurdle Lane day and night, so it's covered'. Sylvanas notes it gives a back wall and little else, and that a captain who liked strangers on his own streets would route them there.
Order of yards along it per Havel: Holt's, Garside's (yard-reeve Tarrant), then the lane opens to Fenner's; Tenter Row opens on the right with the old malt-house at the weir end somewhere beyond.
A dead drop: a crack in the wall at hip height at the mouth of the first loading lane, mortar gone soft; the runner pressed something into it with his thumb.
Havel's capture plan puts his lads at the Hurdle Lane end (and at the weir end of the row); the canvas map has a worn pale line down Hurdle Lane. Havel redraws it in the same groove.

The back lane Sylvanas follows to Kett's is a separate lane: long, straight, loading doors shut and barred, cobbles white with dust, a lamp at each end, no turning, with a water butt and a lean-to at the near corner by which she reaches the roofs.

eventsHere.event: Havel walks Sylvanas down Hurdle Lane naming yards; she notes he points her away from Tenter Row; the runner leaves a drop in the wall crack; at the bell three of the gate men go up Hurdle Lane toward Tenter Row.
